first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender, dark long gun held by Person A, with a long barrel, a protruding front-sight structure, and a prominently mottled light-colored surface.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The dark, uneven muddy ground extending from the foreground to the midground, scattered with bricks, stones, and broken wood, with wet, bright reflections in some areas.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The nearby ruined wall with a rectangular opening, mottled covering, and broken brick-and-stone edges, as well as the lower wall section behind it.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: The cluster of vegetation among the ruins, consisting of gray-black leafless trunks, short branches, and broken stumps.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The smoke clouds and sky beyond the ruined wall, initially tending toward gray-white and gray-black, and tending toward yellow-green on the right in the final frame.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The bright orange-yellow flame area among the ruins; in the final frame, only a distant small bright point is partially visible.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The first-person figure holding a gun, with only part of a dark glove and the gripping outline visible; the face and full body are out of frame.

entities.name: ruins smoke cloud
entities.identification: The gray-white smoke covering the low areas among the ruins and fading the outlines behind it.
